title: Add a Look tab to Edit your Spotlight so theme, fonts and background sit beside the links

source.ref: Follow-up named in LIVE-1953; Daniel said go 2026-11-02

detail: Theme, header, fonts and background lived only in the Appearance rail, away from the page editor. The editor now has a Look tab that hosts the same Appearance module (same owner-gated actions, no new writer), and the live preview follows the chosen theme at once.

verify.evidence: The Look tab and the themed preview are present.
